body.title: urlutil: ignore case of scheme and host when comparing URLs
body.body:
<!--  Thanks for sending a pull request! -->

**What this PR does / why we need it**:

`urlutil.Equal` treated hosts that differ only by case (e.g. `Charts.Example.com` and `charts.example.com`) as different URLs. This compares the scheme and host with `strings.EqualFold` and keeps the path comparison case-sensitive.

Fixes #11

**Special notes for your reviewer**:

Small change to a single function.

- [ ] this PR contains user facing changes (the `docs needed` label should be applied if so)
- [ ] this PR contains unit tests

items.title: fix(urlutil): compare scheme and host case-insensitively in Equal
items.body:
<!--  Thanks for sending a pull request! -->

**What this PR does / why we need it**:

`urlutil.Equal` compared URLs without lowercasing the scheme and host, so `https://Example.COM/charts` and `https://example.com/charts` were not equal. Both are case-insensitive per RFC 3986, so they are now lowercased during normalization. The path stays case-sensitive.

Fixes #11

**Special notes for your reviewer**:

None.
